stages.name: RAW CAPTURE
stages.description: Verbatim, typos included. No autocorrect, no paraphrasing, no editorial decisions.
stages.output: The Raw Archive — unedited, timestamped record of every operator utterance
stages.why: The WAY the operator says something is as important as WHAT. Repetition = emphasis. Profanity = priority. Interruption = urgency.

stages.name: NUCLEAR HARVEST
stages.description: No summarization, signal only. When in doubt, keep it.
not_noise: Any instruction preceded by always or never
stages.nuclear_principle: The compiler can discard in later stages. It cannot recover what was discarded here.

stages.name: SEMANTIC EXTRACTION
stages.description: Identifying behavioral laws from signal corpus
stages.output: The Behavioral Law Set — structured enumeration with citations to Signal Corpus

stages.name: COMPRESSION
stages.description: Minimal footprint, maximum fidelity. NOT summarization — compression is lossless for intent.
techniques: Priority tagging (non-negotiable vs strong preference vs default)
stages.target: Loadable in a single context-window block at session open

stages.name: EXECUTABLE SPECIFICATION
stages.output: The Soul DNA — the executable behavioral specification

thud_factor.definition: The property of raw operator voice that gives it weight. Force — frustration, repetition, profanity — is information.
thud_factor.example_low: Please avoid summarizing content when I've requested verbatim output.
thud_factor.example_high: Stop. Summarizing. My. Words. I said verbatim. Verbatim means every word.
thud_factor.rule: Both convey the same rule. Only one conveys its priority. The compiler preserves Thud Factor through compression.

what_summarization_loses: Emotional register (frustration marks constraints; enthusiasm marks priorities)
Repetition patterns (what gets repeated gets emphasized)
Self-correction sequences (correction is the rule; original is the reason)
Pacing and rhythm (decision speed is part of operational spec)
Edge-case statements ('except when' is often the most important part)
Exact word choices (word choices are the lexicon — the operator's technical vocabulary)
soul_dna_compiler.architectural_distinction: The Soul DNA compiler does not summarize. It compresses. Compression preserves; summarization discards.
